table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname= item.name, 
	itemalias=item.customicode,
	recipient = Case RecipientCode When 1 Then (Select Name From Department Where DeptCode=issueheader.deptcode) When 2 Then (Select Name From Accounts Where AccCode = issueheader.AccCode) When 3 Then (Select Name From Accounts Where AccCode = issueheader.AccCode) When 4 Then (Select Name From SalesMan Where SalesManCode = issueheader.RecipientSalesMan ) End,
	salesman = max(dbo.users.username), 
	issueinvcode = dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode, 
	smanname=max(salesman.name),
	price = Case ( Select a=DBO.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('IssuePriceInPrint')) When 1 THEN max(issuedetail.saleprice) When 2 THEN max(issuedetail.purchaseprice) WHEN 3 THEN max(issuedetail.avgprice) WHEN 4 THEN max(issuedetail.MRPP) END,
	date =max( dbo.issueheader.date),   
	dbo.issueheader.deptcode, 
	remarks=max(dbo.issueheader.remarks),	
	gcode = max(issuedetail.gcode),   
	icode = issuedetail.icode,   
	batch = max(issuedetail.batch),   
	expiry = min(issuedetail.expiry),   
	looseqty = sum(issuedetail.qty),
	referenceno=ISNULL((select name from issuetype where issuetypecode = issueheader.issuetypecode), '') + CASE issueheader.issuetypecode WHEN NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' END + max(dbo.issueheader.referenceno),
	refno=max(dbo.issueheader.referencedate),
	Godown = max(Godown.name),
	itempacking =max( itempacking.name),
	headerno=max(issueheader.headerno),
	Id       = max(dbo.issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL) 
FROM 
	issueheader, 
	issuedetail, 
	users, 
	item 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Godown ON (dbo.item.gcode = dbo.Godown.gcode),
	salesman
WHERE 
	( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = :ar_issueInvCode ) AND
	( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = dbo.issuedetail.issueinvcode) AND
	( dbo.issueheader.Smancode = dbo.SalesMan.Salesmancode ) AND 
	( dbo.issueheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND 
	( dbo.issuedetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)

Group By

Issueheader.issueinvcode,
Issueheader.deptcode,
Issueheader.RecipientCode,
issueheader.issuetypecode,
Issueheader.acccode,
Issueheader.Recipientsalesman,
item.name,
item.customicode,
issuedetail.icode,
issuedetail.rowgroup

order by id
